ordinary_frame.basis: This remains a Mass. The normal formulary appoints Oratio super populum after Postcommunion and before dismissal (Missale Romanum 1962, printed p. 129, numbered text 825; artifact PDF p. 210). The held generic Ordinary frame has no declared place for this prayer, so that frame is unavailable. The Propers remain in their printed order.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Proficiat, quaesumus, Domine, plebs tibi dicata piae devotionis affectu: ut,
sacris actionibus erudita, quanto majestati tuae fit gratior, tanto donis
potioribus augeatur. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum.

propers.incipit: Benedictus es, Domine, doce me justificationes tuas

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
A cunctis nos, quaesumus, Domine, reatibus et periculis propitiatus absolve:
quos tanti mysterii tribuis esse consortes. Per Dominum.
